answer:
The most recent Nobel Prize in Physics for neural networks/deep learning was in **2024** (John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton) [S2][S3]. The most recent Nobel Prize in Physics clearly related to black holes was in **2020** (Roger Penrose, Reinhard Genzel, and Andrea Ghez) [S10][S24].

- **Neural networks/deep learning:** **2024** — Hopfield & Hinton [S2][S3].  
- **Black holes:** **2020** — Penrose; Genzel & Ghez [S10][S24].
